description: This file defines the top-level interface and concepts for device accelerators in PyTorch, including functions for managing devices, streams, and device capabilities.

methods.name: getAccelerator
methods.description: Returns the top-level accelerator device type if available.

methods.name: isAccelerator
methods.description: Checks if a device type is an accelerator.

methods.name: isAcceleratorExcluded
methods.description: Checks if a device type is an accelerator, excluding specified types.

methods.name: deviceCount
methods.description: Returns the number of available accelerator devices.

methods.name: setCurrentStream
methods.description: Sets the current stream for a device.

methods.name: getCurrentStream
methods.description: Gets the current stream for a device.

methods.name: synchronizeDevice
methods.description: Blocks until all work on a device is completed.

methods.name: exchangeDevice
methods.description: Sets the device index and returns the previous one.

methods.name: maybeExchangeDevice
methods.description: Sets the device index if not initialized, returns previous.

methods.name: getDeviceCapability
methods.description: Returns the capability of a device.

methods.name: getMemoryInfo
methods.description: Returns memory information for a device.
